dog.description_text:
Meet Bellingham! 🐾

Bellingham is a brindle girl, one of three females in a litter of five, born right in foster care while her mom was being whelped. She's the quieter one of the bunch, but don't let that fool you — she's smart, fearless, and endlessly affectionate. She's a natural social butterfly too: when a new foster puppy joined the household (not even from her own litter!), Bellingham was the first to welcome her in and get her playing with the group. She loves giving kisses, roughhousing with her siblings, and holds her own with her 45 lb adult foster brother. She's just recently gotten the green light to go outside and is already picking up leash manners nicely. True to puppy form, she plays hard and crashes harder — a classic puppy through and through.

Personality & Characteristics: My foster dog is: House training in progress (currently working on pee pads)

3 Keywords for your pup: Smart, Fearless, Welcoming

Walking Manners: Just started leash walking, picking it up well

Favorite Things: Carrots, and zooming around the kitchen island

ALL adoptions require a completed application and final contract. The application can be found at WaldosRescue.org and once you are approved to adopt you will be put in touch with the foster to see if it’s a good match. We are a RESCUE not a shelter. We conduct veterinary and personal reference checks during the application approval process. We are unable to contact every applicant for every dog. We will select the best applicant for each dog, based on the dogs needs.

Waldos Rescue Pen is a 501c3 whose primary focus is rescuing dogs from the euthanasia list from high kill shelters throughout the United States and Korea.
